metrics.profile_summary: Senior Advertising Account Director with over 10 years of experience managing diverse brands. Expert in 360-degree campaign execution, strategic communication, and leading cross-functional teams in fast-paced environments.

experience.description: Leads advertising and digital campaigns from planning to execution, managing client relationships and coordinating creative, social media, and production teams.
Managed in-store branding for P&G, Walls, and Unilever to increase consumption and brand visibility.
Developed marketing strategies, handled media buying and planning, and coordinated OOH media releases.
Executed campaign briefs, monitored competitor activities, and prepared activity review reports for clients.

strengths: Extensive experience with global brands like Unilever and P&G
Strong leadership and 360-degree campaign management skills
Proven track record in high-level account direction
weaknesses: Significantly overqualified for a Specialist role
No explicit mention of tactical tools like Canva or Meta Business Suite
Experience is more strategic/managerial than tactical/operational
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a highly seasoned advertising professional who exceeds all minimum requirements. However, his profile is that of a Director rather than a Specialist; he may find the tactical requirements of social media scheduling and asset coordination beneath his current seniority level.
